name: Abu al-Ghul al-Tuhawi
bio: Abu al-Ghul belonged to Tuhayya of Tamim. Al-Amidi places him among Banu Abd Shams ibn Abi Sud and gives Abu al-Bilad as another name by which he was known. He connects the name Abu al-Ghul with a tale the poet told in verse about meeting a ghoul in open country. Abu al-Qasim al-Farisi counts him as an Islamic-period poet, and Abu Tammam preserves his praise of the riders who defended al-Waqba. His death date is unknown.
